scope: Authoritative component registry entries; component architecture documents are separately authored documents rather than extra component owner identities.

authorities.role: Canonical registry object; its keys are the graph-membership identity vocabulary.
Authoritative programmatic field validators. Commit-time enforcement only checks newly added component keys; legacy omissions are accepted.
Graph components list values must be exact registry keys.
Explains graph components list versus AC scalar component namespace. Some examples and registry counts are historical; use the current validator and registry for exact values.
Authoring CLI; duplicates the minimum validator but omits full agent/interface enforcement. It is not stronger schema authority than the integrity guard.
Existing mapper sets registry provenance when a graph component ID matches a registry key, but currently discards all registry entry fields.

record_identity.selection: Iterate every object entry under /components once, including registered components with no incoming membership edges.
record_identity.native_id: Exact components object key, with no snake_case/kebab-case rewriting.
record_identity.metadata: The complete original entry object without field filtering, defaults, field renames or injecting derived values.
record_identity.title: Authored name if it is a string, otherwise an empty presentation title; never replace metadata.name.
record_identity.description: Authored description if it is a string, otherwise an empty presentation description; never invent metadata.description.
record_identity.derived: Any classification/provenance facts belong outside metadata. Registry identity and source locator do not need to be copied into authored metadata.
identity_rules: The id field is required by the schema and must equal the registry key, but the key selects identity; a mismatch is a source validation error, not a reason to overwrite authored id.
A detail_ref document stem is not an alias declaration. Do not infer aliases by converting underscore to hyphen.
The AC scalar component namespace/prefix uses a different registry. Do not turn those namespace values into aliases of Component identities.
An architecture document may describe several components; a document path is its own identity and must not be guessed into a single component owner.

fields.name: primary_code
fields.constraints: Non-empty list of non-empty path strings. Preserve source order and values; no existence inference.
fields.legacy_note: infrastructure currently has []; report source debt separately, do not repair it during extraction.

fields.name: detail_ref
fields.conditional_required: New-component commit admission additionally requires a non-empty path to an existing document carrying flight_level.
fields.constraints: Minimum validator allows absent or null; a non-null value must be a non-empty existing path.

fields.name: agent_affinity
fields.constraints: Integrity validator requires an array, allows [], does not validate element shape or references. Do not assume list<string> from its name.

fields.name: exposed_interfaces
fields.constraints: Array may be empty. Each object requires truthy name/type/path/shape; validator explicitly checks only type enum beyond field presence/truthiness.
fields.additional_fields: No additionalProperties restriction is enforced; preserve future nested/scalar fields.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.constraints: Intended list of existing registry IDs; rejects self-reference and unknown IDs. Current validator returns no error for absent, falsey or non-list values; preserve actual authored values and report validation separately.

unknown_fields: Preserve all authored future/legacy fields, including nested objects, arrays, booleans and numbers. Current registry has exactly the 10 field names above; the validator is not an allowlist.
null_empty_absent_semantics: Absent means not authored. Do not fill missing agent_affinity/exposed_interfaces with [] just because newer records require them.

Explicit null detail_ref is distinct from an absent detail_ref and from an empty string; Neo4j cannot store null as an ordinary property, so preserve it in the lossless payload plus typed shape metadata.
[] means an explicitly empty array. Preserve array shape even when Neo4j cannot establish a list element type.
{} means an explicitly empty object. Preserve its shape and pointer even if it has no scalar leaves.
Keep boolean, integer, floating-point, string and collection types; do not string-cast to bypass Neo4j limitations.
Do not sort, deduplicate, infer or rewrite lists. Object-array indexes are needed to retain which interface name/type/path/shape belong together.

native_property_exposure.root_fields: Expose every authored scalar and Neo4j-compatible homogeneous scalar array using its authored field name, subject to the coordinator's explicit collision policy with storage metadata.
native_property_exposure.nested_fields: Expose leaves under escaped JSON Pointer property names, not parallel collapsed arrays. For example /exposed_interfaces/0/name, /exposed_interfaces/0/type, /exposed_interfaces/0/path and /exposed_interfaces/0/shape retain correlation.
native_property_exposure.pointer_escaping: Escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1 in each object token; array positions remain decimal indexes.
native_property_exposure.shape_metadata: Record container type, array length, explicit nulls and empty containers at pointers, using a reserved projection namespace separate from authored properties.
native_property_exposure.round_trip: Preserve complete source entry in payload and verify flattened properties plus shape metadata round-trip without losing authored data.
native_property_exposure.relationships: Additional DEPENDS_ON/detail_ref/primary_code/agent_affinity relationships are optional projection features; they never replace or erase the original fields. Do not infer target record type from a path or undocumented affinity value.

component_document_boundary.recommendation: Emit registry entries as Component. Admit docs/architecture/components/**/*.md as independently path-identified Document records in coordination with the Document coder; preserve their whole frontmatter and body with explicit component membership and registry detail_ref references. If routing retains them under a Component-specialization temporarily, mark their non-registry origin and keep separate identities; never overlay document fields on registry metadata.
component_document_boundary.reason: Registry type describes component responsibility (such as orchestration); document type describes document category (such as reference). name versus title and status also belong to separate records and cannot overwrite one another.
component_document_boundary.document_types: Most frontmatter values are strings or string arrays; created/last_updated parse as authored YAML dates in 33 documents and quoted strings in one. root is boolean in two files; source_ticket is explicit null in one and string in one. Preserve these distinctions.
component_document_boundary.raw_extraction: Use safe frontmatter parsing and preserve body independently. Resolve detail_ref paths inside the supplied immutable snapshot; reject path traversal. Source file and locator provenance must identify the registry entry versus document frontmatter separately.

coder_contract.shared_type: knowledge.native_types.common.NativeRecord(kind, native_id, source_path, metadata, locator, title, description, derived)
algorithm: Read docs/components.json via common.read_json. An absent optional source file may yield []; malformed JSON or a malformed components envelope must fail explicitly rather than silently dropping records.
Require the components value to be a mapping and each entry to be a mapping. Iterate deterministically while leaving entry property and array values intact.
Create one NativeRecord(kind='Component', native_id=key, source_path='docs/components.json', locator='/components/'+escaped_key, metadata=entry) per entry.
Set title and description only from authored string name/description; do not add fallback fields to metadata.
Do not invoke admission validators to rewrite or default legacy records. Expose source debt as diagnostics if the integration requires it.
Coordinate component-document routing separately so every original frontmatter field is exposed exactly once and no fake component hub owner is manufactured.
acceptance_checks: 46 records in the inspected checkout, including the 18 with explicit null detail_ref and entries with no incoming membership.
Each record metadata equals its exact registry entry; metadata key presence and primitive/container types are unchanged.
finalize exposes id, name, type, description, status, primary_code, detail_ref, agent_affinity=[] and exposed_interfaces=[].
ac_store retains explicit detail_ref=null while missing affinity/interface fields stay absent.
decision_kernel retains each exposed_interfaces object with its four correlated fields and original ordering.
Unknown future fields, empty objects, mixed/nested lists and pointer-escaping keys survive raw extraction and downstream native-property round-trip.
agent_registry remains the Component native_id even though detail_ref stem is agent-registry.
No document frontmatter type=reference overwrites registry type=orchestration for finalize.
Malformed registry shapes and traversal refs receive explicit errors, not skipped records or reads outside root.
